lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five vertical columns of high-luminance circular blobs are visible posterior to the fifth gill slit, arranged in a staggered grid pattern with the largest centroids located along the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are present, aligning with the columnar arrangement of blobs to create a series of grid-like anchor nodes across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible in the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity highlights on the dorsal edge and shadows on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A remora is visible attached to the ventral region posterior to the pectoral fin; the pectoral fin itself displays a significantly higher density of smaller high-luminance spots compared to the primary flank patterning.
